title: How to Keep Stink Bugs Out of the House and What to Do If They Get In

seo.title: How to Keep Stink Bugs Out of the House
seo.meta_description: Stink bugs often enter buildings for shelter. Seal gaps, repair screens, and remove indoor bugs without crushing them rather than spraying living spaces.
seo.search_intent: Prevent seasonal stink-bug entry and handle indoor insects through exclusion and physical removal without unnecessary broad pesticide use.

excerpt: Stink bugs often become a household nuisance when they seek shelter in buildings. The best control happens before they pass through window, siding, and utility gaps.
content_html:
Stink bugs found indoors are often seeking shelter rather than breeding in furniture or pantry food. Exclusion before seasonal entry is the highest-value control.

Inspect the exterior shell

Seal gaps around windows, utility penetrations, siding, and trim; repair screens and weatherstripping. Sunny walls can be congregation points before insects move into cracks.

Remove indoor bugs without crushing them

The defensive odor is why they are called stink bugs. Vacuum them with equipment you can empty promptly, or capture them in a container.

Sheltering stink bugs usually do not damage the structure

The main problem is nuisance and odor when handled. That does not justify broad spraying of bedrooms and living spaces.

Activity can spike with temperature changes

Warm winter days may wake insects hidden in wall or attic voids and draw them toward windows. That does not necessarily mean they are reproducing indoors.

If hundreds enter every year

An exterior inspection may reveal gaps that indoor cleanup can never solve. Prioritize sealing and building maintenance before chemical treatment.

The practical strategy is exclusion, careful removal, and patience with occasional insects that emerge from hidden winter shelter.

faq.question: Are stink bugs breeding inside my house?
faq.answer: Those entering for overwintering are usually sheltering; indoor sightings do not automatically mean reproduction.

faq.question: Why do they smell when handled?
faq.answer: They release defensive chemicals when threatened or crushed.

faq.question: Do I need to spray the inside of the house?
faq.answer: Usually exclusion and physical removal are more useful for sheltering stink bugs.
